policies.publicIp: No public-IP request occurs before the explicit disclosed button action; mocked success and failure are both acceptance cases.
policies.copyAll: Support copy excludes the public IP and states that the summary is not a unique device fingerprint.
policies.keyboard: Capture is focus-scoped, history is in-memory and capped at 12, browser/system shortcuts are not prevented, and typed content is never persisted.
